newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP CLOSE SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP CLOSE SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the first day of four-day English county championship matches on Thursday:
At Worcester: Gloucestershire 326-9 (M.Alleyne 149, M.Lynch 70; T.Moody 5-66) v Worcestershire
At Uxbridge: Somerset 289-5 (P.Holloway 109 not out, K.Parsons 72) v Middlesex
At Cardiff: Glamorgan 351-9 (A.Dale 90, M.Maynard 82) v Surrey
At Canterbury: Kent 376-4 (N.Llong 105 not out, C.Hooper 84, T.Ward 79, M.Ealham 54 not out) v Hampshire
At Chelmsford: Sussex 361-8 (A.Wells 122, I.Salisbury 69 not out, N.Lenham 55) v Essex
